prerequisites: Successful completion of the basic studies (Bachelor's pre-examination). A maximum of 6 CP from the first three semesters may be missing.

learning_outcomes.text: Successfully apply knowledge acquired at the university to corporate tasks.
Expand theoretically acquired knowledge by working on practical, engineering tasks.
Document and present work results professionally.
Expand teamwork skills through participation in operational working groups.
Deepen intercultural competence (especially during an internship abroad).
Better assess one's own strengths and weaknesses.
Better plan the further design of the studies.

syllabus_topics: Practical activity in an industrial company or other suitable training company for 95 attendance days.
Involvement in current company projects in the areas of development, production, or sales.
Projects dealing with topics from mechatronics and related fields.
Practical application of knowledge acquired at the university.
assessment_rules: The examination is based on practical work lasting 95 days. As a prerequisite (XP), a written assignment (duration: one semester) and a presentation (duration: 10 minutes) are required. Specific details on the prerequisites will be provided at the beginning of the semester.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
